name: znetwork_dplay_enum_sessions_for_current_app
description: zNetworkDPlay::EnumSessionsForCurrentApp clears cached sessions and enumerates DirectPlay sessions for g_zNetwork_AppGuid.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited because GUID field copies are split into word/byte assignments in HLIL; assembly validates the contiguous 16-byte app GUID copy into the session descriptor.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x48be70 validates unconditional ClearEnumeratedSessionList, zero return when g_zNetwork_pDirectPlay4 is null, zeroed 0x50-byte zNetworkDPlaySessionDesc, size 0x50, g_zNetwork_AppGuid copied into desc.appGuid, and IDirectPlay4::EnumSessions called with timeout 0, callback zNetworkDPlay::EnumSessionCallback_AddSessionDescCache, null context, and flags 0x82.

Native smoke znetwork_dplay_enum_sessions_for_current_app_smoke verifies the no-DirectPlay return path and the active DirectPlay EnumSessions arguments, app GUID copy, callback pointer, flags, and HRESULT propagation.
